subQuests.subQuestName: Begin the first round of special training

150350103.text: Your training will be split into three stages, testing your bladework, elemental abilities, and reasoning skills.

150350104.text: We'll start with bladework. You're no rookie in this area, so I won't bore you with the basics.

150350105.text: During your long journey, you've no doubt sparred with a lot of talented sword fighters. Consciously or not, you have picked up all kinds of techniques from them.

150350106.text: You bet! There's Kaeya, Master Jean, Keqing... Oh, and Kazuha, Ayaka... Yeah, we've met sword masters like you in every nation we've been through.

150350107.text: You sparred with a bunch of them too, right? Nice to know it's all gonna come in handy now!

150350108.text: Don't get too smug. In sword fighting, techniques alone are not enough — you need a cohesive system to bring it all together. A "style," or "school" of fighting.

150350109.text: To use the human body as an analogy, your style is your skeleton — the foundation, the framework. Techniques are the muscles and other flesh attached to the bones. This is where your strength comes from.

150350110.text: Improving your sword fighting is like growing that body. If your frame got bigger and taller but you didn't add any muscle mass, you'd be weak and flimsy. Then again, if you packed on pounds of flesh without a big enough frame to support it, you'd end up bloated and unwieldy.

150350113.text: You need to do some introspection. Take a good, hard look at your past experiences, and figure out which parts of what you've learned are just techniques, and which parts can be used to form your own system of bladework.

150350114.text: Only then will you get the full utility out of all your thoughts and observations along the way. Only then will every strike you deliver make perfect sense.

150350116.text: #Paimon thought you were gonna teach {NICKNAME} some cool new moves... Like when you went "swoosh" and opened a tunnel to another place!

150350117.text: One day, you'll reach a new level of power where you realize that even that's as basic a trick as any other. But right now, our sword styles are so wildly different that teaching you mere techniques is pointless.

150350118.text: There are no shortcuts in the pursuit of power. Failure is your best teacher, and rigor is your coursework.

150350119.text: That's all I have to say. Time to make a start — train until you're satisfied with yourself.

150350301.text: (Amazing... This is transforming my whole view of sword work. I'm using the same techniques as ever, but now they're having different effects.)

150350302.text: (It's as if I've unlocked a hidden door in my mind, and there's a wellspring of strength on the other side.)

150350303.text: (In my mind's eye, I'm seeing images of the friends I've made in Teyvat. Theirs are the sword styles and techniques I have come to know...)

150350304.text: "This moment will be frozen in time."

150350306.text: Consider a moment of true mastery that you've witnessed in another person, and ask yourself — what lies beneath the surface? What's their guiding philosophy, what's their state of mind as they maneuver their weapon?

150350307.text: Now take that, and practice it right away with speed, skill, and strength... Over and over, until your hand is one with your mind. This is the only path to true growth.

150350310.text: "I see eternity go by in an instant, the autumns of many years from a single leaf. Thus I shall slice this maple in a flash, and ask a question of the ages..."

150350312.text: If you start to tire, empty your mind but do not stop.

150350313.text: Stay in that frame of mind as you keep up the fight. Get rid of all redundant movements. Imagine your sword is an extension of your own body. Wield it just as you wield your arms, hands, and fingers.

150350314.text: "'Twas on a deserted moonlit night that the hero approached the vile dragon's limpid lair... Raincutter!"

150350315.text: "Feathers fleeting wet, the white heron treads water, a sight without flaw. Master of Inazuma Kamisato Art Tachi Jutsu..."

150350316.text: (With each slash of my blade, I feel my strength increasing... I don't know if my weapon can contain all this power...)

150350317.text: (I'm in the zone. Limitless power is surging through me...)

150350319.text: You slash and swipe till you've exhausted every ounce of your energy...

150350321.text: Huh... Looks like you've made some real progress. That concludes your training session.

150350322.text: Awesome! Paimon knew you could do it!

150350326.text: As you should be. Time flies when you're training hard. You've actually been going for several days now with no rest.

150350327.text: Yeah, meanwhile Paimon's had a whole bunch of naps! But you were so focused, she didn't wanna interrupt you.

150350328.text: Go get some sleep — I'll be doing the same very soon. Let's hope you see that foggy place in your dream, so I can get this investigation over and done with.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the makeshift camp and rest
Go to the makeshift camp and rest

150350402.text: (Have I been pulled back into that place again? But Skirk said the dream-mirroring would kick in when I fall asleep... so why am I back here?)

150350403.text: (...No, on closer inspection, this isn't the same dream as last time. It's dark and gloomy, but there isn't that chilling fog that made my hairs stand on end.)

150350404.text: (...Hold on, if dream-mirroring is a two-way process... Maybe I'm seeing inside her mind while she's exploring mine?)

150350405.text: (If this is her inner world, it's pretty bleak... I can occasionally make out the sound of a flowing stream, but other than that... it's so empty.)

150350408.text: (What a strange-looking creature — where did it come from? ...I think it wants me to follow it. Might as well see where it leads.)

150350501.text: Skirk, why are you skipping classes again? We've talked about this!

150350502.text: Cause he's a crabby old man, and he's a boring old man! I don't like going to his classes!

150350503.text: Excuse me!? You shouldn't talk about your teacher like that, it's very disrespectful!

150350504.text: Alright, let's not get into a big fight about this. Skirk's learned what she needs. There's no point forcing her to sit through more classes if she doesn't want to be there.

150350505.text: But I'd still love to hear about what you got up to yesterday. Why don't you tell your dad all about it?

150350506.text: I went diving! And I saw this huuuge fish. I never knew they could get that big! It looked kinda dumb though, with that stupid big fat head. I tried to shake its fin, but it just spat water at me.

150350507.text: Oh, and today, I'm gonna go to that prairie up north! There's supposed to be this giant bird there that can spit fire! I bet, if I climbed on its back, it could fly me all the way to the stars!

150350508.text: Hahaha, then I suppose your old dad should get one as a pet too. Otherwise, how are you gonna hear me call you for dinner up there in the stars?

150350509.text: When it's time to eat, I'll come back on my own, silly... Anyway, gotta go! Bye, Mom! Bye, Dad!

150350510.text: Wait... Put on a coat, at least! You'll catch a cold! I'm talking to you, young lady!

150350511.text: You spoil that child, you know. Ever since that merchant ship arrived, she practically lives outside. Always going on about "exploring the beyond one day," whatever that means.

150350512.text: Ah, let the kid do what makes her happy. Besides, we both know you're all bark and no bite. C'mon, our little adventurer's gonna be hungry when she gets back. Let's get started on dinner.

150350601.text: ("The stars shimmer high above"... But, what lies beyond the stars?)

150350602.text: (Mountains as far as the eye can see? An endless snowy plain? Or, maybe buildings taller than the sky, like the people from the merchant ship said.)

150350603.text: (I can't be the only one asking these questions — the universe is fascinating. If only I could meet some other people like me, we could set sail together and explore every corner of the world!)

150350604.text: (I'm sick of being a kid... There's so many amazing things out there, and I'm ready to see them all!)

150350605.text: (But, for now... I'm starving. Better get back.)

150350702.text: Don't let a single one of them get away!

150350706.text: Fire... There's fire everywhere! What happened?

150350707.text: I told you we shouldn't have trusted these "outsiders"!

150350708.text: Why are you doing this? What did we do to deserve this?

150350709.text: We welcomed you with our finest food and drink, showed you the best our home has to offer, gifted you cloth dyed by our own hands... And this is how you treat us?

150350711.text: Captain, zone three is clear and we have zone two surrounded.

150350712.text: Begin extermination. Remember the orders from upper command — no one is to be left alive.

150350713.text: Rest assured, sir. We have enough munitions to annihilate these savages and burn their entire civilization to the ground.

150350714.text: Good. The only ones who put up a real fight are that man and his wife, correct? What's their status?

150350715.text: We shot the man in the ankles, and the wife broke her wrist attempting to fight back. They won't be doing much more fighting. They're holed up in their home for now, but they won't last long.

150350716.text: To prevent them from making some kind of last stand, we're planning to clear out the other zones first so we can send a bigger squadron to surround them.

150350717.text: Well, well. Turns out some of these beasts do know how to use their claws. Now, the "threat" these savages pose will be undeniable.

150350718.text: Let them cling to what's left of their lives for a little longer. Once the other zones are cleared, I'll cut off their heads myself.

150350803.text: So happy to see you, sweet girl. But, you need to go... It isn't safe here. They'll be back any second...

150350804.text: What happened? You're bleeding a lot! Dad... Mom... *whimper*

150350805.text: Hehe, this is the place. Alert all units. Prepare to surround.

150350806.text: Run, Skirk! Run as far away as you can! Don't trust anyone!

150350807.text: Your dad and I, we're not afraid to stare death in the face. But, we need you to survive.

150350808.text: My clever girl, so curious... You're already so brave. I know you're going to grow up to be such a positive light in this world.

150350809.text: Whenever you miss us, just play this song.

150350810.text: Remember... Life is a gift. Don't let darkness claim it.

150350811.text: Break down the door! Look what we have here. A savage that can pluck a tune! Well, the show's over!

150350812.text: You! Stop singing! Shut it! I said shut it, or I'll make you! Fine, have it your way...!

150350904.text: I found a few clues while you were asleep, but it's only a start. Now, time for the second stage of your training.

150350905.text: This time, the focus is elemental energy. Come find me when you're ready to begin.

subQuests.subQuestName: Begin the second round of special training

150351001.text: Man, staying in the Abyss feels so surreal, don't you think?

150351002.text: No day, and no night — it's like time hardly exists. If we weren't careful to keep track, it feels like we'd have no idea how long we've even been here.

150351003.text: Well, except for the fact that Paimon still gets hungry like clockwork... You go do your training. Paimon's gonna grab a bite.

150351005.text: The way I see it, the pursuit of power is divided into three stages.

150351006.text: The first is mastering the use of standard weapons. Next is learning how to harness natural energy. And, after that, you're free to challenge even higher dimensions.

150351007.text: The "natural energy" of Teyvat is, of course, elemental energy. But that's not my area of expertise — I draw from a different source of power.

150351010.text: Abyssal power, yes. Also known as the power of the Void Realm.

150351011.text: My master, Surtalogi, is a true expert in that area. After all, he was one of the group of five that infamously stole the all-encompassing power of the Abyss, an act for which the people of Khaenri'ah gave them the epithet "The Five Sinners."

150351012.text: The elemental energy of Teyvat, on the other hand, is derived from the power of the Light Realm. These two forms of energy exist in direct opposition to each other. Suffice to say, there's not much I can teach you this time.

150351201.text: (Along my journey, I've gained different elemental abilities in different lands.)

150351202.text: (But... I've never trained them all at once like this.)

150351203.text: You need to understand what makes you special.

150351204.text: The ability to wield elemental energy without a Vision and switch between the elements at will...

150351205.text: It means your aspirations need no approval from the gods. Your power is not bound by the rules of this world.

150351206.text: So, be bold. Do not be afraid to chart your own path.

150351207.text: (Graceful as the wind. Tough as stone. Nimble as lightning. Flourishing like foliage...)

150351208.text: (I can feel the power of the elements flowing through me. Sometimes, as peaceful as a flowing stream. Other times, surging like a raging river.)

150351209.text: (If I close my eyes, I can almost hear their voices. But, it's not like some wild beast battling me for dominion. It's more like... saying hello to an old friend.)

150351211.text: Very good. It seems you've reached a deeper level of connection with the elements.

150351214.text: Long enough for you to lose yourself in your training — which is a good sign. Relentless practice with the elements has drained all your strength, but it's also what allowed you to make progress.

150351215.text: Get some rest. When you wake up, we'll proceed to the final stage of your training.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the makeshift camp and rest
Go to the makeshift camp and rest

150351406.text: (No response. The strange creature just floated away.)

150351407.text: (What is that thing? What is it doing in Skirk's inner world? And... where is it taking me this time?)

150351501.text: What is the secret to power?

150351502.text: Longing? Hatred? Self-preservation? No... It is fear.

150351503.text: The fear of losing those you love. The fear of watching your home burn. Fear of loneliness, fear of death...

150351504.text: Fear is the source of evolution — it forces humanity to adapt to their environment and overcome hardship. It is in the process of prevailing over our fears that we surpassed first ourselves and then the rest of the world.

150351505.text: That fear is now part of you. It calls on you to evolve, and it is time to answer.

150351601.text: Any minute spent missing home is a minute wasted — practice your sword work instead. Do not make me tell you twice.

150351602.text: But, Master... I can barely lift the sword anymore. If I keep going, I feel like my wrist is going to break...

150351603.text: So, it has not broken yet?

150351605.text: Then, pick up your sword and keep practicing until it breaks — I want to hear the cracking and splintering of bone.

150351606.text: After all, bones can always be reset.

150351701.text: Good, Skirk. Once again, you survived. How do you feel?

150351703.text: These are signs that you are adapting to the Abyss.

150351704.text: Each time the flesh is torn and the spirit crushed, each time you claw back from the brink of death, you become stronger.

150351705.text: I now understand why these people sought to destroy your homeland. Your potential goes beyond even what I could have anticipated.

150351707.text: But, you still have much to learn in your pursuit of strength. Your mind is rife with distractions. From now on, I shall show no mercy in your training.

150351708.text: You must learn to shut out all the pointless emotion, crush the self that makes you weak, and become master over your physical form.

150351709.text: Get up, Skirk. Wipe the blood off your face, cut away the rotten parts of your flesh, and mend what is broken. Then, take up your sword.

150351801.text: (The dream is over, but I can't get that suffocating, oppressive feeling out of my head.)

150351802.text: (I have so many questions about Skirk's past... Where does she come from? What has she been through?)

150351803.text: You're up! Hopefully, you got some good rest.

150351804.text: Skirk said to tell you that she's ready to start the final stage of your training whenever you are.

150351805.text: So, wanna head over now? Or, did you wanna wait a little?

150351806.text: (I really want answers, but right now it's vital that I complete my training...)

150351807.text: (Once that's done, I'll find a chance to talk to her.)

subQuests.subQuestName: Begin the third round of special training

150351901.text: From your training so far, you have gained a better command of the sword and more control over your elemental abilities.

150351904.text: That's only part of it. Experience is the real teacher. Your journey, the friends you have made, the dangers you have faced — these have taught you more than I ever could.

150351905.text: Now, it's time to focus on how you react under pressure. You must be able to think rationally, even in unpredictable combat situations. To simulate this, I'm going to attack, and you're going to block.

150352101.text: (It's not easy to control my emotions.)

150352102.text: (The battle is overwhelming, but... if I can just focus all of my attention on what my opponent is doing and how I should respond, it's almost like my emotions take a back seat.)

150352103.text: You're getting the hang of it.

150352104.text: The first step to controlling your emotions is controlling your mind. You want a unified train of thought. It all comes down to focus.

150352106.text: (I think it's working... I can choose to tune out anything that isn't relevant to the battle. But, I think I'm still pretty far from having full control over my emotions.)

150352107.text: Your mind is rife with distractions. From now on, I shall show no mercy in your training.

150352108.text: You must learn to shut out all the pointless emotion, crush the self that makes you weak, and become master over your physical form.

150352109.text: (Skirk went through this kind of training too, didn't she... How merciless does the training have to be to make someone substitute all emotion for pure reason?)

150352110.text: Stop. Let's pause here. One look, and I can tell your mind has wandered.

150352111.text: That's to be expected. There's a limit to how long a human being can concentrate on one thing. Staying calm and focused sounds simple in theory, but in practice, it's more demanding than sword work or elemental abilities.

150352112.text: (Skirk is right. Now that I've stopped, all the emotions I was suppressing are rushing back to the surface.)

150352113.text: (Pain, exhaustion, frustration, doubt... But, exhaustion is the main one. I feel like I could fall asleep on the spot...)

150352114.text: Get some rest — no point training further if you're already dead on your feet. Like I said at the beginning, the only goal of this training is for you to reach a point that you're satisfied with.

150352115.text: You managed to push past your limits, which is a good start. You can be proud of that and sleep well knowing that you've earned it.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the makeshift camp and rest
Go to the makeshift camp and rest

150352301.text: (Looks like I'm back in Skirk's inner world.)

150352302.text: (I don't see that strange creature this time. But, I think I can navigate this space on my own now, even without it here to guide me.)

150352303.text: (I don't know how to leave, so I'm stuck here until I wake up. Can't hurt to take a look around while I wait...)

150352401.text: Skirk is amazing! She faced down that terrifying giant and cut its head clean off!

150352402.text: She got hurt though, didn't she? I heard it was pretty bad...

150352403.text: Yeah, well that's a given. But the moment she was on the mend, she got right back to practicing her sword work.

150352404.text: I heard Master suffered a grave injury once too. Lost an arm and a leg, and still came back stronger than ever... Skirk's becoming more like him by the day.

150352405.text: Incredible... I wonder if I'll ever reach their level. They're always so resolute, so unshakable...

150352502.text: Pathetic... You're not even trying. You're so much weaker than you think.

150352503.text: Skirk, have you become a positive light in this world?

150352505.text: Do you even remember how many of us perished in that fire? How many bodies were left to rot on the scorched earth? Yet, you alone live on.

150352506.text: Keep your gaze fixed on your blade. You don't deserve to rest.

150352507.text: I have so many questions! I just wanna jump in a spaceship, explore the whole universe, and get answers from the stars! I just need to wait till I'm grown up... Then, I can do anything...

150352508.text: Now, you must bid farewell to who you were in the past, and become someone stronger.

150352509.text: Run, Skirk... Run! Only death awaits us here. Keep running, and don't ever look back...

150352601.text: Hmm... Let's see here. First things first, you need a new identity.

150352602.text: Going around telling people you're from somewhere beyond the stars won't do, now will it? How about saying you hail from "beneath the earth" instead?

150352603.text: As the Khaenri'ahn saying goes: "Venturing out into the universe and down into the abyss are the same in that both are braving the dark unknown."

150352604.text: Well, I'm a visitor on this planet, so I'll follow the rules.

150352605.text: Ah, splendid! That saves me quite a bit of trouble. Let me offer you a piece of advice in return — although it might not be what you want to hear.

150352606.text: I know the pursuit of strength is important to you. But, taking a moment for yourself every once in a while is never a bad idea.

150352608.text: Ignore "her" existence for too long, and there will come a day when you can no longer hear "her" voice.

150352702.text: (The dream is over. I can hear the crackling of a fire in the distance, and there's a fragrant aroma in the air... Mmm, grilled meat...)

150352704.text: You must be starving, right? Ta-da! A barbecue feast just for you!

150352707.text: Hehehe, of course you are! That's why Skirk and Paimon got this all ready for you. Dig in, before it gets cold!

150355101.text: Sometimes, you have to practice a single movement a million, maybe ten million times, before the breakthrough moment comes. Nothing in the outside world can help you in this process — the most important thing is to remain patient.

150355201.text: If you wish to master the elements at a fundamental level, you must see the entire natural world — nature in all its places and forms. That is part of what it means to be a traveler.

150355301.text: Warriors will train day and night to perfect their skills, but when the battle comes, their fate may be decided in a matter of seconds.

150355302.text: One mistake, one moment of hesitation, and just like that, all their blood, sweat, and tears were for nothing. You need to push yourself to perfection, or you might not even live to regret it.

150359901.text: You train the elemental powers one by one, ending with Hydro...
